cohort: 100 pregnant women admitted to a tertiary hospital between June 2019 and June 2020 with placenta previa
finding: Type 3 placenta previa was the most common type (46%), 95% of cases were managed with emergency cesarean section, and scarred uterus was associated with a higher risk of placenta previa, particularly type 3.
mod_finding: 95% of cases were managed with emergency cesarean section.
